description: A dark-haired, bearded man with a stern scowl stands in a dim marble hall, wearing a red cloak over dark metal armour with a short dagger at his waist. Behind him to the right is a round gold-framed painted panel showing a bearded older man, a woman with pale hair, and a boy, with one figure's face scraped and splintered away. Ornate columns, arches, a carved stone pedestal and a candle sconce fill the background. No visible text.
